plugins.name: rs-research
plugins.description: Understand a market, prospect company or competitor before anything is scoped; sharpen discovery questions; turn a vague client complaint into a sharp problem statement. Ends where client-facing documents begin.

plugins.name: rs-scoping
plugins.description: Client notes, transcripts or emails to opportunity packet, BRD, PRD, technical design and a man-day estimate priced against the rate card. The chain that ends in a number. Not for presenting or selling it.

plugins.name: rs-sales
plugins.description: Win scoped work: proposal and platform decks, startup pitch decks, contracts, outbound campaigns, and review of client-facing material before it goes out. Not for producing the scope.

plugins.name: rs-content
plugins.description: Write what is published under the RightShift name: LinkedIn posts, case studies, traction pieces, speaking-engagement campaigns, one-pagers, editorial and client-communication QA, and the voice guide they follow. Not for client deliverables.

plugins.name: rs-design
plugins.description: Interface and visual design (SaaS UI in Figma, design reference to CSS spec) and evaluating a page, site or Figma file against its brief. Also brand identity. Not for building it in code.

plugins.name: rs-prototype
plugins.description: Something running or clickable fast: HTML or Next.js prototypes, Spark or Propel engagements, and deciding which prototype features become the MVP. Not for production delivery.

plugins.name: rs-delivery
plugins.description: Ship an approved PRD: per-feature specs a coding agent can execute, then design-briefed, prototype-gated, TDD-implemented, QA-verified features shipped as a PR linked to the ticket. Not for prototypes or deciding what to build.

plugins.name: rs-qa
plugins.description: Risk-based test strategy and coverage matrix, executable Gherkin test cases, and Playwright runs against a live application with real verdicts. Not for code review.

plugins.name: rs-project-management
plugins.description: Run sold work: map a PRD into Linear sprints and tickets. Not for deciding what to build or writing code.

plugins.name: rs-product
plugins.description: Training course that teaches team leads to turn a client's stated want into a spec a designer and engineer can build from. Training, not production.

plugins.name: rs-chatbot
plugins.description: Build a knowledge-grounded chatbot for a client or internally, define its personality rulebook, and specify how it behaves and falls back when it does not know.

plugins.name: rs-common
plugins.description: Shared utilities other rs-* plugins lean on: D2 diagram rendering and the document formatting standard. Install alongside anything else.

plugins.name: rs-guard
plugins.description: Enforced delivery gates as hooks: blocks dangerous git, and PRs without commit-bound receipts (tests passed; on ticket branches, prototype approved and QA with no failing P0). Checks required tools at session start. No dependencies, so the gates stay on.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Third-party (Matt Pocock, MIT): engineering skills — /grill-with-docs design interview, /to-spec, /to-tickets, TDD, diagnosing bugs, code review. rs-delivery's design front door.
